key: Home of the Move Relearner
en: Home of the Move Relearner
ja: わざ思い出しの家

key: Onyx Arcade- Test your skills!
en: Onyx Arcade- Test your skills!
ja: オニキスゲームセンター――腕試ししてみよう!

key: Gotta say, I don't feel half as bad about losing to you before after seeing your reputation coming around in these parts.
en: Gotta say, I don't feel half as bad about losing to you before after seeing your reputation coming around in these parts.
ja: あんたがこの辺で評判になってるの見たら、前に負けたのもそこまで悔しくないって思えるよな。

key: Some of them won't admit cuz they're stuck in the past, but everyone here knows about you.
en: Some of them won't admit cuz they're stuck in the past, but everyone here knows about you.
ja: 昔にこだわって認めないやつもいるけど、ここにいるみんなあんたのこと知ってるぜ。

key: Keep sayin' you're the one saving Reborn and whatnot.
en: Keep sayin' you're the one saving Reborn and whatnot.
ja: あんたがリボーンを救ってる張本人だとかって、みんな言い続けてるよ。

key: Heh, not to mention, whalloping Fern's ass.
en: Heh, not to mention, whalloping Fern's ass.
ja: へっ、それにファーンをぶちのめしたこともな。

key: Tch, it's great and all that Florinia cared enough to help out with the restoration...
en: Tch, it's great and all that Florinia cared enough to help out with the restoration...
ja: チッ、フロリニアが復興を手伝うほど気にかけてくれるのはいいことだけど……

key: But were the multiple school-wide community service days really necessary?!
en: But were the multiple school-wide community service days really necessary?!
ja: 学校ぐるみの奉仕活動が何日も必要だったのかよ?!

key: I signed up to study, not to scrub streets!
en: I signed up to study, not to scrub streets!
ja: 俺は勉強するために入学したんであって、道路を磨くためじゃないんだよ!

key: Hey!
en: Hey!
ja: よう!

key: I remember you! We fought before you got super popular, remember?
en: I remember you! We fought before you got super popular, remember?
ja: あんたのこと覚えてる!超人気になる前に戦ったよな、覚えてる?

key: Aah, that's so cool!
en: Aah, that's so cool!
ja: ああ、めっちゃかっこいい!

key: Can I help you in your grand quest to restore the region!?
en: Can I help you in your grand quest to restore the region!?
ja: 地方復興っていう壮大な冒険、あたしも手伝っていい!?

key: I mean, do you need a sidekick?
en: I mean, do you need a sidekick?
ja: つまり、相棒とか要らない?

key: Or-- oh! Take this!
en: Or-- oh! Take this!
ja: それか――あ!これあげる!

key: Yay, I'm helping the great \PN!
en: Yay, I'm helping the great \PN!
ja: やった、あたし偉大な\PNの役に立ってる!

key: Wait until everyone hears that I met you!
en: Wait until everyone hears that I met you!
ja: みんなにあんたと会ったって話したら、驚くだろうな!

key: I know construction and repair is supposed to be important and all...
en: I know construction and repair is supposed to be important and all...
ja: 建設とか修復とか大事なことなのはわかってるけど……

key: But destruction is way better!
en: But destruction is way better!
ja: でも破壊の方が全然いいよな!

key: Julia has the right idea! We should just blow up all the buildings that are in the way!
en: Julia has the right idea! We should just blow up all the buildings that are in the way!
ja: ジュリアの考えは正しいぜ!邪魔なビルなんて全部吹っ飛ばしちまえばいいんだ!

key: I wish I'd been put in charge of that instead. That would've been a blast, literally!
en: I wish I'd been put in charge of that instead. That would've been a blast, literally!
ja: それこそ俺が担当だったらよかったのに。まさに爆発的に楽しかっただろうな!

key: Heyyy, check it out, \PN's back!
en: Heyyy, check it out, \PN's back!
ja: よお、見ろよ、\PNが戻ってきたぞ!

key: We saw you before when you were challenging the Gym. Sweet plays!
en: We saw you before when you were challenging the Gym. Sweet plays!
ja: ジムに挑戦してた時のあんたを見たぜ。いいプレーだったな!

key: After the city restoration stuff got underway, Headmistress Florinia was one of the first people to get involved in it.
en: After the city restoration stuff got underway, Headmistress Florinia was one of the first people to get involved in it.
ja: 街の復興作業が始まってから、フロリニア校長は真っ先に関わり出した人の一人だったんだ。

key: She may act emotionless, but she really cares about this city!
en: She may act emotionless, but she really cares about this city!
ja: 感情がないみたいに振る舞ってるけど、この街のことは本当に大切に思ってるんだよ!

key: Oh my god, it's \PN!
en: Oh my god, it's \PN!
ja: うそ、\PNだ!

key: You've traveled all over, right?!
en: You've traveled all over, right?!
ja: あちこち旅してきたんでしょ?!

key: Then surely you've met the famous Amaria!
en: Then surely you've met the famous Amaria!
ja: じゃあ絶対、あの有名なアマリアに会ったことあるよね!

key: What's she like? Is she cool? I bet she's cool!
en: What's she like? Is she cool? I bet she's cool!
ja: どんな人?かっこいい?絶対かっこいいよね!

key: I hope she's doing great! She's doing great, right?!
en: I hope she's doing great! She's doing great, right?!
ja: 元気にしてるといいな!元気にしてるよね?!

key: Tch, everyone keeps talking about some \PN.
en: Tch, everyone keeps talking about some \PN.
ja: チッ、みんなやたら\PNの話ばっかりしてるな。

key: What'd they do to get so popular all of a sudden?
en: What'd they do to get so popular all of a sudden?
ja: 急に人気になるなんて何をやったんだ?

key: What about me?
en: What about me?
ja: 俺はどうなんだよ?

key: MAN: *HUFF PUFF* I... finally... caught you...
en: MAN: *HUFF PUFF* I... finally... caught you...
ja: 男:*ハァハァ*……ついに……捕まえたぞ……

key: LILLIPUP: Rrrr...uff!
en: LILLIPUP: Rrrr...uff!
ja: ヨーテリー:ウー……ワン!

key: MAN: Lillipup... I... can't keep... *HUFF* doing this...
en: MAN: Lillipup... I... can't keep... *HUFF* doing this...
ja: 男:ヨーテリー……もう……こんなこと……*ハァ*……続けられないよ……

key: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff!
en: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff!
ja: ヨーテリー:ワン!ワン!

key: MAN: I'm... sorry, but... this is too much...
en: MAN: I'm... sorry, but... this is too much...
ja: 男:すまない……けど……もう限界だ……

key: I just can't keep up with you in my life.
en: I just can't keep up with you in my life.
ja: お前についていくことが、俺の人生の中でどうしてもできないんだ。

key: Hm, I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...
en: Hm, I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...
ja: ふむ、どこかで見たことがある気がするな……

key: I'm sorry if I don't remember meeting you... Lillipup takes so much out of me I can barely keep up.
en: I'm sorry if I don't remember meeting you... Lillipup takes so much out of me I can barely keep up.
ja: 会ったこと覚えてなくてすまないな……ヨーテリーの世話でくたくたで、ついていくのがやっとなんだ。

key: I hate to say it, but... I don't have the energy to give Lillipup the attention and care it needs.
en: I hate to say it, but... I don't have the energy to give Lillipup the attention and care it needs.
ja: 言いたくないんだが……ヨーテリーが必要としてる世話や愛情を注ぐ元気が、もう俺にはないんだ。

key: You seem like a pretty strong young Trainer.
en: You seem like a pretty strong young Trainer.
ja: あんたはかなり強そうな若いトレーナーに見えるな。

key: Would you be willing to look after my Lillipup?
en: Would you be willing to look after my Lillipup?
ja: 俺のヨーテリーの世話を、してもらえないか?

key: Really? That's... I feel bad, but, it's a big relief.
en: Really? That's... I feel bad, but, it's a big relief.
ja: 本当か?それは……申し訳ないけど、正直すごく助かるよ。

key: Go ahead.
en: Go ahead.
ja: どうぞ。

key: Now I'm just gonna rest right here...
en: Now I'm just gonna rest right here...
ja: さて、俺はここでちょっと休むとするか……

key: Ah, no, no worries... I understand, it's... It's a lot to handle.
en: Ah, no, no worries... I understand, it's... It's a lot to handle.
ja: ああ、いや、気にしないでくれ……わかるよ、その……大変だもんな。

key: Now I'm just gonna... rest right here for a while...
en: Now I'm just gonna... rest right here for a while...
ja: さて、俺はしばらく……ここで休むとするか……

key: Hey, you. I remember you.
en: Hey, you. I remember you.
ja: よう、お前。覚えてるぞ。

key: We're gonna have a rematch someday. I'll catch up to you, mark my words.
en: We're gonna have a rematch someday. I'll catch up to you, mark my words.
ja: いつか再戦してやる。必ず追いついてやるからな、覚えとけよ。

key: Just... probably not when I'm still in school.
en: Just... probably not when I'm still in school.
ja: ただ……たぶん学校に通ってる間は無理だけどな。

key: These term projects are killing me.
en: These term projects are killing me.
ja: 学期末の課題がマジでキツい。

en: "Onyx Trainers' School, formerly the Pokémon Technical Institute- Reborn's #1 Ivy League School"
ja: 「オニキストレーナー学校、旧名ポケモン工科学院――リボーン随一の名門校」
